## Paper Cart 0.1.9

To update, quit Paper Cart, run `brew upgrade paper-cart` in Terminal, then start `paper-cart` again. Your papers and reading statuses carry over.

### Changed

- Abstracts use larger text: 14px, up from 12px, the same size as the author and journal lines.
- Paper Cart now checks for a newer version every time it starts, instead of at most once a day, so the update notice appears as soon as a release is out. When you're offline, it skips the check and tries again at the next start.
